name: Durin
title: Warehouse Keeper

warehouse/31312.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Durin: Over the last century, Rune Castle Town's warehouse has never lost any items to accident or theft. Not even one! How about that? We are the pride of the Iron Gate Guild. You can certainly trust us to protect anything you deposit with us, friend!

links.text: Pick up an item - Private Warehouse
Pick up an item - Clan Warehouse

warehouse/31312-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Jeeper Durin: The things I've learned as a guild member can only be imparted to Dwarven fighters, scavengers or bounty hunters. I don't have anything to teach you.

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
